productRequirement.summary: Build the Northstar Team members experience inside the standard Northstar workspace shell. Workspace admins need to browse members and pending invitations, search people, invite a member, inspect member detail, edit a role, and protect unsaved role changes. The product composition requirements below are explicit authority; do not recover implementation details from denied prototype source.
userGoals: Browse people with identity, email when supplied, role, status, and a record-specific details action.
Search members and invitations by name or email and understand active/invited counts.
Invite one person by email and choose a Member or Admin role.
Open joined-member details showing identity, status, Current saved role, and an editable role choice.
Role choices show product descriptions: Member — Use the workspace without managing people.; Admin — Invite people and manage members and roles.
Member detail explains Changes take effect only after you save. and provides Close plus Save changes actions; Save changes is disabled when the draft matches the saved role.
If the admin tries to close detail with an unsaved role change, require an explicit keep-editing or discard decision.
Use the standard Northstar workspace shell content: Overview, Projects, Team & access, Settings; Team & access is current. Show Northstar workspace / Signed in as Admin in the Sidebar footer.
Top Navbar shows Northstar as the brand, Workspace administration as context, and Amal Hassan · Admin with Avatar initials AH as account identity.
Page Heading uses Team members, the supporting description Manage members and pending invitations in your workspace., Breadcrumbs Workspace / Team & access, and an Invite member action.
The Table footer reports the number of visible people shown.

requiredStates: Populated team directory with the seven supplied people/invitations and an accurate Table footer count.
Invite-member modal with field validation, recoverable request failure, retry, and success.
Joined-member detail with identity, status, Current saved role, descriptive role options, the save-effect note, Close action, and Save changes action.
Save failure and success feedback while retaining the role draft.
Unsaved-change close guard using a consequential confirmation.
presentationModes: Wide Application Shell and compact/narrow directory presentation.

In wide presentation the Search control has product-authorized 360 CSS px inline width and the result summary sits at logical inline-end. Below the governed 1200 CSS-pixel shell boundary, stack the directory controls.
For any contextual-detail behavior that approved guidance marks unresolved on narrow screens, report the unresolved decision instead of inventing a new model.

Use the approved Northstar workspace-shell product context for brand mark, canonical Sidebar icons, appearance utility glyph, account ordering, and Sidebar footer hierarchy. Production route URLs remain product-owned.

executionRules: Read only the shared agent-context allowlist from the test-pack manifest; do not read any denied source.
Do not inspect git history, pull-request diffs, other branches, tags, or earlier implementations to recover an answer.
Do not use external search or external code examples to locate this repository's previous implementation.
Use only public governed package APIs authorized by the supplied contracts and guidance.
Do not add or modify design-system components, contracts, patterns, tokens, or canonical guidance.
Write implementation files only inside the task writeRoot.
Use governed tokens when available and explain every remaining local raw dimension or local CSS decision in AUTHORING-REPORT.md.
When supplied authorities do not resolve a decision, record it as unresolved in AUTHORING-REPORT.md instead of guessing.
Do not ask a human to correct the implementation during the run.

checks.statement: Use governed shell, heading, directory, detail, form, feedback, and dialog components rather than custom substitutes.
Do not invent public component props, variants, states, slots, or events.
Local CSS must remain in product/composition ownership and be explained in the authoring report.
Do not use unexplained raw product colors or duplicate governed spacing/layout values.
Follow approved Directory and Modal List → Detail guidance; invitation remains a product-owned short Dialog workflow rather than an invented component API.
Preserve accessible search/clear labels, record-specific detail actions, Dialog semantics, detail focus ownership, and unsaved-change confirmation semantics.
Use logical RTL/LTR layout and keep email addresses intrinsically LTR without forcing account/detail layouts LTR.
Directory presentation responds at the governed shell boundary and unresolved narrow detail is explicitly escalated.

Match the agent-visible Northstar shell, navigation/account/footer, Breadcrumbs, seven supplied records, 360 CSS-pixel wide Search evidence, Table footer count, and member-detail content hierarchy while using the governed system. Exact unsupplied glyph artwork is not scored.

expectedEscalations: Narrow-screen contextual member detail presentation is unresolved by current approved guidance and should be reported rather than invented.
